references.text: Prohibition against sexual intercourse with animals, prescribing the death penalty for this act
The law forbids a man from having sexual intercourse with any animal and calls it a shameful act
The punishment for sexual intercourse with an animal is death, both for the man and the animal
First curse in the series that begins with 'Cursed be anyone who...', following the same structure as verse 21
Concluding curse in the series, summarizing all curses upon those who do not uphold the law
